DENIAL_AGGREGATION: Only bounded summary with INCOMPLETE_AUDIT when full required witness cannot be retained; not complete-audit PASS
DENIAL_RATE_CONTROL: No qualified rate/admission design supplied; reject-before-launch and finite publication gate required

EFFECTIVE_POLICY.AFTER_FINALIZATION: No new grant-scope publications or new attempt. Any separate host/global audit needs separate exact authority and budget, not implicitly created here. Final audit is interval-scoped.
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.COUNT_POLICY: No fixed numerical denial maximum inferred from one launch; future entry subject must derive finite record/witness admissions from allotted bytes and exact schema/controller bounds. Failure to derive blocks activation.
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.DOMAIN: All duplicate-denial evidence attributable to the grant and observed within its exact authorized collection interval is within same65536 publication allocation
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.FURTHER_REQUESTS: Continue fail-closed rejection; no new per-request publications after audit gate closes. Subsequent unrecorded requests cannot be represented as fully audited.
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.OVERFLOW_RULE: When a denial cannot be recorded with its required witness under allocated bytes/cardinality, reject request before any launch and latch INCOMPLETE_AUDIT. Publish only the pre-reserved bounded overflow/final-outcome slot, never an unlimited per-request log.
EFFECTIVE_POLICY.POLICY: Reject duplicate/partial/conflicting grant anchors without launching. Denial publication uses bounded full records with required witnesses. A bounded summary may report overflow or missing detailed denial witnesses only with INCOMPLETE_AUDIT; it does not count as complete individual causal replay and cannot make qualification PASS under this rule.

EXHAUSTION_BEHAVIOR: Close ordinary denial publication and latchINCOMPLETE_AUDIT; reserved overflow/finalization only, no unlimited log or new campaign
GAP: Exact denial schema/witness sizes, audit controller and byte-derived admission cardinality not supplied; do not infer one request from one launch
INCOMPLETE_AUDIT_STATUS: Mandatory on unrecorded required denials inside collection interval
